**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) # huashu-art-motion · 艺术动画 让你的coding agent，把艺术风格写成会动的画。 36种艺术风格 · 9种解说语法 · 8种参数化片段 · 口播整片参考代码 ```sh npx skills add alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion ``` [看动画](#动画样片) · [看风格](#看效果) · [开始使用](#里面有什么) · [下载完整样片](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest)
## 动态 - 2026-10：[Open Design](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design)（nexu-io 出品的开源 AI 设计工作区）的 [motion-design skill](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/blob/main/skills/motion-design/SOURCES.md) 把 huashu-art-motion 列为设计来源之一，并在 [skills/huashu-art-motion](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/tree/main/skills/huashu-art-motion) 收录了一份适配版，保留了 MIT 许可和上游出处。很高兴这套艺术动画的做法被另一个开源项目用起来，谢谢 Open Design 团队。也欢迎更多项目使用、反馈和贡献。 ## 动画样片 ### 核心案例：花叔闯进超级玛丽 把自己做成像素主角，跑完一整关。砖块、水管、关卡运动与转场用代码完成，人物用生成帧合成；下面直接截自65秒成片。 连吃蘑菇都得先选会员：OpenAI，还是Claude？选完Claude，星芒道具落下来，花叔变大。

连踩带踢 · 像素Sam与Dario客串敌人
钻进水管 · 金币密室与扫描线甩镜
这组展示的是成片效果；GIF无声、循环播放。[片段时间点与导出参数](assets/showcase/mario-clips.md)。 ### Clawd 博物馆奇妙夜 Claude Code 的像素吉祥物 Clawd 从保安电脑的终端里蹦出来，打着手电夜巡纽约大都会博物馆，再穿过中央公园去自然史博物馆，天亮前赶回来装成展品。98秒，16个场景，无口播，配乐也是代码合成的。 跳进梵高《麦田与柏树》：笔触方向取自原作的结构张量，Clawd被重画成厚涂。

霸王龙骨架 · 追手电光斑
天亮 · 装成展品眨一下眼
暗处是炭笔夜景，只有手电照到的地方显出颜色；入画的五幅（梵高、修拉、维米尔、伦勃朗、勒茨）都是大都会开放获取的CC0原作，按各自画家的笔法用代码重画。完整成片在[Releases](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest)，[片段时间点与说明](assets/showcase/clawd-clips.md)。 ### 花叔穿越名画 画里真的会动。下面三段来自同一支穿越短片，场景用代码画，角色用生成帧合成。 日本桥上的一次水漂。

古埃及 · 圣甲虫
8-bit · 顶出金币
## 看效果 35段样片各取一帧：同一位少女、同一只橘白猫、同一张桌子，从公元前 40000 年的岩洞一路穿到 2026 年。每一段都在动：梵高的星空在转，马赛克的颜色从石块上流过去，水墨晕染把画面带进下一个时代。 注意：这 35 格用的是同一个构图，那是艺术史速通片的机制（风格在变、场景不变），不是这些风格的构图。做新题材要为题材重新构图，别把这间屋搬过去。 👉 [下载全风格样片（MP4）](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest) 长卷穿越片：一个人从左走到右，跨过边界的那一刻，世界和他自己的画风一起换（下图是收进仓库的 3 段示范：埃及壁画 → 莫奈《日本桥》→ 8-bit）： 8种解说语法各有一支可运行示范片（下图每镜取一帧）。此外还有第9种「讲解员式财经科普」，提供语法卡和需自备角色的整片代码快照。白板适合跟着口播画关系，Vox适合图形与信息拼贴： | | | |---|---| | Kurzgesagt：扁平无描边、尺度穿行 | Vox：剪报、红线、荧光笔 | | 白板：笔尖揭开线稿 | 3Blue1Brown：一个对象形变成下一个 | | Storytime：反应特写、笑点停顿 | 动态文字：主词砸进来 | | 发布会：光斑底、毛玻璃卡、大数字 | 财经图表：先轴、后数据、只标一件事 | --- ## 能做什么 | 你说 | 它做 | |---|---| | 「复刻这个动画」「拆一下这段」 | 先跑拆解脚本量出转场、节拍网格、每段运动热图，再按机制用代码复刻 | | 「做个梵高／莫奈／包豪斯那种的动画」 | 先设计一帧，再让它动起来；36张风格配方卡当起点 | | 「用我的口播做一段艺术动画」 | 镜头表 → 定风格 → 世界画布加镜头 → 输出一条画面轨 | | 「做一个人穿过一幅幅名画的片子」 | 长卷骨架：每个世界一个段文件，主角一路往右走，跨边界换画风，镜头只进不退 | | 「做解说视频的动画段」 | 按口播选语法，喂一份 JSON，出一段时长精确到帧的片段（横竖屏、可透明底） | | 「画面里要有人」 | 人交给生图模型出帧，代码负责合成、换帧和材质 | | 「配个乐、卡节奏」 | BPM 网格、动机换乐器、结尾音效序列，纯代码合成 | 交付前有一道数字验收：`qa.py` 量稳定、效率、动感、流畅及文字框景线索，再派一个没参与制作的 agent 只看成片挑问题；最后 `deliver.py` 一条命令交付——成片先过反 PPT 门禁（整片几乎没有镜头内快动作就红灯，不出片），过了才复制成片、写交付说明，说明里的事实由脚本写。 --- ## 里面有什么 | | 数量 | |---|---| | 艺术风格配方卡（参数、母题动作、签名转场、当前短板） | 53张，`references/风格配方/`；其中 38–55 是按原作锚定重做的研究配方（含敦煌壁画） | | 对应的场景代码 | 53个，`scripts/engine/scenes/` | | 解说动画语法卡 | 9份；其中8种附示范片、参数化片段与示例spec | | 口播整片参考代码 | 混合风格、白板、Vox、讲解员；需自备部分素材，详见目录README | | 长卷穿越片示范（骨架＋3 段＋角色帧库） | 1 支，`scripts/engine/demos/long_scroll/` | | 版面审计与压测（出界／叠字／字太小、竖屏／超长／英文变体、示例回归） | `render.py --audit`、`scripts/clip_lint.py`、`scripts/analyze/stress_clip.py`、`regress_clips.py` | | 转场 | 艺术风格签名转场与解说转场，包含淡入、硬切和纸面转场 | | 绘画与动画库（笔刷、渲染器、后期、骨架、镜头、图表、排版……） | 17 个，`scripts/engine/lib/` | | 方法文档（拆解、机制、一帧先行、纯代码绘制、节奏配乐、角色、长卷……） | 核心12篇，`references/01`–`12`；另有[可选语音指南](references/capabilities.md) | ``` huashu-art-motion/ ├── SKILL.md # 先判断任务，再按表读对应文档 ├── references/ # 01–16方法文档、53张风格配方卡、9张语法卡、正面经验 ├── assets/ # 总览图（README 用） └── scripts/ ├── engine/ # 可整个复制走的动画工程：引擎、转场、库、场景、示范片、片段 ├── analyze/breakdown.py # 把参考动画拆成「能写代码的地图」 ├── qa.py # 一键验收 ├── film_gate.py # 成片门禁：量翻页式 PPT 感、查中段空画面（只读 mp4） ├── deliver.py # 一条命令交付：门禁→复制成片→写交付说明 ├── audio/ # 纯代码合成配乐的模板 └── font_subset.py ... # 字体子集、绿幕抠图 ``` 依赖：[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)、ffmpeg、Playwright Chromium（第一次跑 `uv run --with playwright playwright install chromium`）。试一下： ```sh cd huashu-art-motion uv run --with playwright python scripts/engine/render.py --solo 09_postimp --stills 0.3 --out 试渲 # 梵高那一段的一帧 uv run --with playwright python scripts/engine/render.py --spec scripts/engine/examples/t3_finance_chart.json --out 财经图表.mp4 ``` --- ## 背后的故事 2026 年 10 月初，我在 X 上看到 Tak（[@cherry_mx_reds](https://x.com/cherry_mx_reds/status/2106095190285144331)）的一支 15 秒动画：一位少女和一只猫穿过 40000 年艺术史，每个时代只有一秒左右，但画里的东西都在动。 我让 Claude 复刻它。第一版是「一张张画之间做转场」，被我否了：原片每个时代可能就一秒，但画里的元素完全是流动的。于是改成先拆解（量转场、拟合节拍网格、看每段哪里在动），再用代码一层层把画画出来、让它动起来。 做的过程中我跟它说：「我们不只是为了复刻，我需要你积累经验。」所以这个 skill 里记的不只是代码，还有哪些做法被证明有效（`references/07-正面经验.md`）、每种风格的坑和短板。之后又派了 4 组只读 skill 的 agent 去做它没见过的 20 种风格，把它们各自造的轮子收成统一的库；再加上 8 种 YouTube 解说动画语法，接进了我自己的口播视频管线。最后用同一套东西做了《花叔穿越名画》：23种画风、2分08秒，我从洞穴一路走到 2026，骨架和其中 3 段也收进来了。 --- ## 致谢 - **Tak（[@cherry_mx_reds](https://x.com/cherry_mx_reds)）** 的《Art History Speedrun》是这个 skill 的起点。16 个艺术时代的场景构图和「少女＋猫穿越」的设定沿用了原片的思路，画面全部用代码重新画，配乐脚本里是原创示例乐谱（只保留拆解方法，不保留对原曲的转录）；仓库里不含原片的帧、截图或音频文件。想看原作请去他的 X。 - 解说语法卡里拆解过的频道和资料（Kurzgesagt、Vox、3Blue1Brown、RSA Animate、TheOdd1sOut 等）都在各张卡的「一手参考」里给了链接，仓库只记测量出来的参数，不含他们的画面。 - 字体都是 SIL OFL 1.1 开源字体，清单和版权见 `scripts/engine/lib/fonts/LICENSES.md`。 --- ## --- ## English **News (2026-10):** [Open Design](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design), an open-source AI design workspace from nexu-io, lists huashu-art-motion as a design source in its [motion-design skill](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/blob/main/skills/motion-design/SOURCES.md) and includes an adapted copy at [skills/huashu-art-motion](https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/tree/main/skills/huashu-art-motion), with the MIT license and upstream link kept. We're glad to see this approach to art animation used in another open-source project, and thank the Open Design team. More projects, feedback and contributions are welcome. **huashu-art-motion** is an agent skill for making animation with code, where the paintings actually move. It ships 36 art-style recipes (cave painting, Egyptian murals, Van Gogh, Klimt, Bauhaus, Kirby comics, 8-bit, vaporwave, Shinkai and more), with 35 Canvas scenes plus a standalone SVG Rick & Morty-style example; 8 explainer-video grammars (Kurzgesagt, Vox, whiteboard, storytime, kinetic type, 3Blue1Brown, keynote UI, finance charts) with demo films and parameterized clips you drive with a JSON spec, frame-accurate and in landscape, portrait or alpha; a long-scroll skeleton where a character walks left to right through one painting after another (3 sample worlds included); plus a breakdown script that maps a reference animation into cuts, beat grid and motion heatmaps, and a QA script that measures stability, cost per frame, motion and smoothness. It started as a code-only recreation of Tak's ([@cherry_mx_reds](https://x.com/cherry_mx_reds/status/2106095190285144331)) 15-second *Art History Speedrun*. The scene layouts and the girl-and-cat premise follow his original; every frame here is redrawn in code, and no frames, screenshots or audio from the original are included. Install: `npx skills add alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion`. Requires uv, ffmpeg and Playwright Chromium. The skill content is in Chinese. The ninth grammar, presenter-led explainers, ships as a reference implementation and requires your own character assets. Full-narration examples are code snapshots, not ready-to-render projects. Code and docs are MIT; the bundled stroke medians retain the Arphic Public License; bundled fonts keep their SIL OFL licenses; the Huashu character artwork, including its appearance in overview images and demo videos, is for demo use only. Clawd is Anthropic's Claude Code mascot; the *Clawd: Night at the Museum* clips are an unofficial fan demo, not affiliated with Anthropic and not covered by MIT. Paintings in it are The Met Open Access (CC0) images redrawn in code. ## 可选媒体能力 基础代码动画不需要语音或图片账号。有素材先沿用；需要生成时，按用户选择和当前环境调用。语音支持macOS系统声音和自己的火山复刻音色；图片支持现有文件导入和当前Agent/MCP工具桥接。 - [语音与私人配置](references/capabilities.md)：按需配置、可跳过，旧koubo入口兼容。 - [图片工具接入](references/images.md)：先生成计划，由Agent调用工具，再验收并收纳素材。 - [兼容性与验证范围](references/compatibility.md)：三家安装重装通过；Codex在线回归通过，Claude Code/Kimi在线回归受测试账户条件阻塞，待补验。 - [维护、扩展与发布](CONTRIBUTING.md)：公共默认与私人配置分离，升级不覆盖个人选择，发布检查覆盖实际待发Git对象。 先运行`python scripts/capabilities.py status --explain`。新增能力默认未选择、未授权；不能从检测到Key或工具推断允许消费。独立图片API执行器为后续可选扩展，不会自动切换供应商。 ## 感谢反馈 感谢[@ismilewolf-eng](https://github.com/ismilewolf-eng)（[PR#1](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/pull/1)）、[@noahark](https://github.com/noahark)（[PR#2](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/pull/2)）提供Windows并发加载故障的修复建议与验证，[@nctt777-hue](https://github.com/nctt777-hue)（[Issue#3](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/issues/3)）提供详细的复现、对照实验与复测，以及[@GFXfly](https://github.com/GFXfly)补充macOS排查反馈。这些反馈帮助我们修复了渲染与QA本地服务的并发加载问题。 ## 第36种：Rick & Morty风格 新增[风格配方](references/风格配方/37_rick_morty.md)与[可复制示例](scripts/engine/reference_films/rick_morty/index.html)：离线预览、拖时间、可控目光/眨眼/端杯/猫跳动和逐帧视频导出。内部ID是37_rick_morty（36_picasso_blue已占用）。这是独立SVG管线；上方35格历史总览和Canvas gallery不包含本例。下载后打开示例HTML即可预览，导出命令见配方。

More projects, feedback and contributions are welcome. ## Animation showcase ### Featured demo: Huashu enters Super Mario Turn yourself into a pixel-art hero and play through a whole level. Bricks, pipes, level movement, and transitions are built in code; the character is composited from generated frames. These clips come directly from the 65-second film. Even eating a mushroom requires choosing a subscription: OpenAI or Claude? Choose Claude, and a starburst power-up drops in to make Huashu grow.

Stomp and kick · Pixel Sam and Dario cameo as enemies
Down the pipe · Coin chamber and scanline whip transition
These show the finished film. The GIFs are silent and loop. See [clip timestamps and export settings](assets/showcase/mario-clips.md). ### Clawd: Night at the Museum Clawd, Claude Code's pixel mascot, jumps out of the terminal on a security guard's computer, explores New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art with a flashlight, crosses Central Park to the natural history museum, and returns before dawn to pose as an exhibit. The film runs 98 seconds across 16 scenes, with no narration. Its music is synthesized in code too. Inside Van Gogh's *Wheat Field with Cypresses*, brushstroke directions come from the original painting's structure tensor, and Clawd is redrawn in impasto.

T. rex skeleton · Chasing the flashlight
Dawn · Posing as an exhibit, with one blink
The darkness is rendered as a charcoal night scene; color appears only where the flashlight shines. The five paintings Clawd enters—by Van Gogh, Seurat, Vermeer, Rembrandt, and Leutze—are CC0 originals from The Met's Open Access collection, redrawn in code using each painter's brushwork. Find the full film in [Releases](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest), with [clip timestamps and notes](assets/showcase/clawd-clips.md). ### Huashu walks through famous paintings The paintings actually move. These three clips come from the same journey film: scenes are drawn in code, and characters are composited from generated frames. Skipping a stone by the Japanese Bridge.

## See the results One frame from each of 35 animated demos: the same girl, orange-and-white cat, and table travel from caves in 40,000 BCE to 2026. Every scene moves: Van Gogh's starry sky turns, mosaic colors flow across stones, and ink washes carry the image into the next era. The shared composition is part of the art-history speedrun: styles change while the scene stays the same. It is not a prescribed composition for these styles. For a new subject, design a new composition rather than reusing this room. 👉 [Download the all-style demo (MP4)](https://github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion/releases/latest) The long-scroll demo follows a character walking from left to right. At each boundary, both the world and the character change art style. The repository includes three sample worlds: Egyptian murals → Monet's *Japanese Bridge* → 8-bit. Eight explainer animation grammars each have a runnable demo film; the images below show one frame per shot. A ninth, presenter-led finance explainers, includes a grammar card and a full-film code snapshot that requires your own character assets. Whiteboard works well for drawing relationships alongside narration; Vox works well for graphics and information collage. | | | |---|---| | Kurzgesagt: flat shapes without outlines, journeys across scales | Vox: clippings, red lines, highlighter marks | | Whiteboard: a pen tip reveals the line drawing | 3Blue1Brown: one object transforms into the next | | Storytime: reaction close-ups and pauses for jokes | Kinetic type: key words land with impact | | Keynote UI: light spots, frosted-glass cards, large numbers | Finance charts: axes first, then data, with one thing highlighted | --- ## What it can do | You ask | It does | |---|---| | “Recreate this animation” or “Break down this clip” | Runs the breakdown script to measure transitions, a beat grid, and motion heatmaps for each segment, then recreates the underlying mechanisms in code | | “Make an animation in the style of Van Gogh, Monet, or Bauhaus” | Designs one frame first, then animates it; 36 style recipe cards provide starting points | | “Make an art animation from my narration” | Builds a shot list → chooses styles → adds a camera to a world canvas → outputs a visual track | | “Make a film of someone walking through famous paintings” | Uses the long-scroll skeleton: one segment file per world, a hero moving rightward, style changes at boundaries, and a camera that only moves forward | | “Make an animated segment for an explainer video” | Chooses a grammar for the narration and renders a JSON spec into a frame-accurate clip, in landscape or portrait, with optional transparency | | “I need a person in the scene” | Uses an image-generation model for character frames; code handles compositing, frame changes, and materials | | “Add music and time it to the action” | Synthesizes music in code using a BPM grid, motifs passed between instruments, and a closing sequence of sound effects | Before delivery, `qa.py` measures stability, efficiency, motion, smoothness, and cues for text-box framing. An agent that did not make the film then reviews the finished output. Finally, `deliver.py` handles delivery in one command: the film must first pass an anti-slideshow gate. If almost the entire film lacks fast action within shots, delivery is blocked. Once it passes, the script copies the film and writes delivery notes using measured facts. --- ## What's included | Component | Quantity / location | |---|---| | Art-style recipe cards: parameters, motif motion, signature transitions, and current limitations | 36 cards in `references/风格配方/` | | Corresponding scene code | 35 scenes in `scripts/engine/scenes/` | | Explainer animation grammar cards | 9 cards; Each era lasts only about a second, yet the things inside the paintings keep moving. I asked Claude to recreate it. The first version just transitioned between still paintings. I rejected it: even when the original spends only a second in an era, the elements within the painting are in motion. So we started with a breakdown—measuring transitions, fitting a beat grid, and checking where each segment moves—then drew and animated the paintings layer by layer in code. During the process, I told it: “We're not just recreating this. I need you to learn from it.” The skill therefore records both the code and the practices that proved useful (`references/07-正面经验.md`), along with each style's pitfalls and limitations. Later, four groups of agents, given only the skill, built 20 styles it had not seen before. Their reusable components became a shared library. We added eight YouTube explainer animation grammars and connected them to my narrated-video pipeline. Finally, I used the same tools to make *Huashu Walks Through Famous Paintings*: 23 styles over 2 minutes 8 seconds, walking from caves to 2026. Its skeleton and three sample worlds are included here. --- ## Acknowledgments - **Tak ([@cherry_mx_reds](https://x.com/cherry_mx_reds))** and his *Art History Speedrun* inspired this skill.
